competences.description: Attacks the enemy target to inflict Continuous Damage without a turn limit. This attack ignores immunity and Reflect Harmful Effect effects.
Attacks all enemies to inflict 2 Continuous Damage without a turn limit. This attack ignores immunity and Reflect Harmful Effect effects.

Creates a shield that cannot be removed. The boss is invincible while having the shield, but the shield is removed when the HP is reduced by 5% or more from the damage that ignores damage reduction effects.

Counterattacks the enemy after getting attacked 10 times. Inflicts additional damage equal to 10% of the enemy's MAX HP for each Continuous Damage inflicted on the target. Increases the boss' Attack Power permanently after counterattacking. [Automatic Effect]
